d: Jharkhand samet deshbhar men govardhan puja aur chitragupt puja ki dhum dekhne ko mili. jamshedpur men purv mukhyamantri arjun munda ne kali puja ke avsar par mahaprasad ka vitran kiya. vahin, bhaee duj ka parv kal manaya jaega. dusri or, yuva aadivasi netri nisha bhagat ki aatmahatya ke mamle ko lekar jharkhand ki rajniti garma gaee hai. bhajpa netaon ne is mudde par rajy sarkar ko ghera hai. raksha rajy mantri aur purv mukhyamantri ne mamle ki nishpaksh janch ke lie sibiaaee janch ki mang ki hai. vahin, palamu men puja visarjan ke dauran do alag-alag sthanon par hinsak jharap ki ghatnaen…
